parameters.query:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT id, type::text AS type, priority::text AS priority, context_snapshot
  FROM omar.escalations
  WHERE phone = $1 AND created_at > now() - interval '90 seconds'
  ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO omar.escalations
    (phone, type, priority, summary, customer_email, order_id, screenshot_url, context_snapshot)
  SELECT $1, $2::omar.escalation_type, $3::omar.priority, $4,
         NULLIF($5,''), NULLIF($6,''), NULLIF($7,''),
         COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role', m.role, 'body', m.body, 'at', m.created_at) ORDER BY m.created_at)
                   FROM (SELECT role, body, created_at FROM omar.messages WHERE phone = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10) m), '[]'::jsonb)
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recent)
  RETURNING id, type::text AS type, priority::text AS priority, context_snapshot
)
SELECT id, type, priority, context_snapshot, 1 AS is_new FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT id, type, priority, context_snapshot, 0 AS is_new FROM recent WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
LIMIT 1;
UPDATE omar.escalations SET alerted_at = now() WHERE id = $1 AND $2::boolean RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Is New Escalation?
nodes.notes: dedup gate: is_new=1 (اتعمل insert جديد) → رنّة تيليجرام. is_new=0 (تكرار خلال 90 ثانية) → ack صامت، مفيش رنّة.
